title: Interpretable machine learning analysis to identify risk factors for diabetes using the anonymous living census data of Japan
summary: Interpretable ML on Japanese living-conditions census data identifies diabetes-associated factors, including several reported as new associations. These are cross-sectional associations, not causal risk factors; there is no external validation. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
